## Change summary

Describe the skill or runtime capability changed and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] Active instructions remain host-neutral.
- [ ] Upstream Biomni examples and exact originals are unchanged, or a new source archive and provenance record are included.
- [ ] Source IDs, retrieval dates, SHA-256 hashes, and license observations are current.
- [ ] Changed skills pass `quick_validate.py`.
- [ ] Added adapters accept explicit paths and provide dry-run or command preview.
- [ ] Target-host fixture or smoke-test evidence is attached.
- [ ] Missing capabilities and scientific limitations are documented.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private data, model weights, or large generated outputs are committed.

## Validation evidence

List exact commands, host/profile information, inputs, expected results, and observed results.

## Runtime and licensing gaps

State any unresolved host binding, dependency, dataset, model, API, or redistribution constraints.
